_source: UDWR 2026-27 Waterfowl, Upland Game and Turkey Guidebook; UDWR 2026 Big Game Field Regulations Guidebook; UDWR 2026 Big Game Application Guidebook
_note: Dates are as published for the 2026 seasons. The 2027 big game application window is not yet published; the scraper watches for it.

deadlines.title: Ptarmigan season closes
deadlines.detail: Last day. Mirror Lake Highway also closes for winter in November, so access shuts at roughly the same time.

deadlines.title: Confirm WMA digital access permit
deadlines.detail: New for 2026. Anyone 18+ needs the free WMA digital access permit OR a valid hunting/fishing/combo license to enter a WMA in Davis, Salt Lake, Utah or Weber County. Free at wildlife.utah.gov/wmas after reviewing the educational materials. Valid 365 days.

deadlines.title: Get annual Walk-In Access authorization number
deadlines.detail: Free, separate from your hunting license, required for every WIA visit. wildlife.utah.gov/walkinaccess/authorization

deadlines.title: HIP number + federal duck stamp before the duck opener
deadlines.detail: Duck opens Oct 3 in the Northern Zone. HIP registration is required for all waterfowl hunters; federal duck stamp required at 16+.

deadlines.title: Call the Box Elder WIA landowners
deadlines.detail: Four of the seven Box Elder hunting WIA properties require contacting the landowner before access, and RSorensen explicitly will not accept a voicemail. Make these calls well before the Nov 7 pheasant opener.

deadlines.title: Ogden Bay WMA - portion closed today
deadlines.detail: A portion of Ogden Bay WMA is closed for a sponsored youth/beginner pheasant hunt. Hunt Harold Crane or the Box Elder block instead.

deadlines.title: Last day at Wallsburg WMA
deadlines.detail: Wallsburg WMA closes Dec 1 through Apr 30. It is the closest stocked pheasant and the best chukar ground to the Heber house, so use the November window.

deadlines.title: Dec 1 WMA closures take effect
deadlines.detail: Timpanogos, Loafer Mountain, Dairy Fork, Lake Fork, Birdseye, Starvation and Hobble Creek WMAs all close Dec 1 through Apr 30.

deadlines.title: Brigham Face and Coldwater Canyon WMAs close Jan 1
deadlines.detail: Closed Jan 1 until the second Saturday in April. Middle Fork WMA closes on the same schedule.

deadlines.title: Utah big game application window opens (projected)
deadlines.detail: PROJECTED from the 2026 cycle, which ran March 19 - April 23 with results by May 31. UDWR has not published the 2027 dates; the scraper watches for them and will correct this entry.

deadlines.title: Utah big game application CLOSES (projected)
deadlines.detail: PROJECTED from the 2026 cycle (closed April 23 at 11 p.m. MDT). This is the single most consequential deadline of the year - missing it costs you the whole draw and a point. Apply at utahdraws.com.

deadlines.title: Antlerless application window closes (projected)
deadlines.detail: PROJECTED from the 2026 cycle (June 9-23). Also the second chance to apply for big game bonus/preference points if you missed the spring window.

deadlines.title: Fall turkey harvest report due
deadlines.detail: NEW for 2026: mandatory harvest reporting within 30 days of season end, even if you harvested nothing. Miss it and you cannot apply in the next limited-entry turkey draw without paying a $25 late fee.
